events.title: IEEE Day
events.description: IEEE Day celebrates the first gathering of IEEE's founders in 1884. Join IEEE ISIMA SB to celebrate with activities, games and the IEEE community!

events.title: IEEEXtreme
events.description: IEEEXtreme is a 24-hour global programming competition where teams of IEEE student members solve a set of programming problems. Form your team and take the challenge with IEEE ISIMA SB!
